comments.text: Two team-launcher tooling issues hit live during the Arc 74 (stoa--x5t) launch. (1) BRIEF-FILENAME BRITTLENESS: launch-team.ps1 -ArcId derives the brief filenames as HUMAN_paste-polybius_<slug>-<ArcId>-instruction.md + HUMAN_paste-pliny-<ArcId>-instruction.md with ArcId = the FULL ticket id, but the historical attachment convention is inconsistent (arc-61, arc67, yh2.1, stoa--xa4 all differ) -- so a brief attached under any other name silently fails to resolve and the -ArcId path cannot launch. I had to re-attach the Arc 74 briefs under the full-id names to make the script work. FIX: make the launcher resolve the brief robustly (glob attachments/<ArcId>/HUMAN_paste-polybius_*-instruction.md + pliny, or accept an explicit --fm-brief/--pl-brief, or standardize + enforce the naming at attach time). (2) RECORD-SEAT PREFIX HARDCODE: record-seat writes the seat registry to stoa--reg regardless of project -- correct at the-stoa, but a non-the-stoa consumer (stoa_of_science) gets a mis-prefixed stoa--reg ticket in its own bw. FIX: derive the registry ticket prefix from the project's bw prefix, not hardcode stoa--reg. Both NON-BLOCKING; tooling hardening. [from: user-tier Polybius_the_Stoa | sid 990b0750-5572-4836-b9c7-18d626a12e96]

Arc 75 (charter stoa--2ln) landed PART 1; PART 2 DEFERRED -- this ticket STAYS OPEN for pt2. PT1 DONE (merged 75f9da0): launch-team.ps1 -ArcId brief resolution now prefers the canonical name, falls back to a git -C ProjectDir ls-tree glob of the beadwork attachment dir, and fails loud on zero/ambiguous -- smoke-tested across canonical-amid-multimatch + glob-fallback + zero-match (NOMOS independently re-ran all three). Fixes the silent can't-find-the-brief break I hit on Arc 74.

PT2 DEFERRED (registry-ticket prefix): the launcher CANNOT derive the prefix via a bare 'bw config get prefix' -- bw is git-bash-only and is NOT on the PowerShell PATH, so the call silently fails and falls back to stoa--reg (proven live: a stoa_of_science dry-run still emitted -Ticket stoa--reg). The ROBUST fix reuses record-seat.ps1's existing Resolve-GitBashWithBw (Arc 68 / stoa--pk4 rev3 C1: derives git-bash FROM git's own location, dodging the WSL bash.exe shadow). EITHER replicate it in the launcher to run 'bw config get prefix' through the resolved git-bash, OR (cleaner) move the prefix derivation INTO record-seat.ps1 (already resolves bw robustly + runs in the project context): change its default -Ticket from hardcoded 'stoa--reg' to a derived <prefix>-reg, fallback stoa--reg. Real surgery on the load-bearing registry writer -> its own careful pass, not folded into the lean Arc 75. NON-BLOCKING (cosmetic mis-prefix in a non-the-stoa consumer). [from: user-tier Polybius_the_Stoa | sid 990b0750-5572-4836-b9c7-18d626a12e96]

title: team-launcher hardening: brittle brief-filename convention + record-seat stoa--reg hardcode
